dedupe_keys.name: schedule not slipstream replication code for co optimising platoon formation refrigeration and vehicle to grid exchange in electric cold chain fleets

description: The study authors publish replication code for scheduling electric refrigerated vehicles. Zenodo provides a MIT-licensed ZIP containing a wake model, compressor law, a CVXPY lower-level programme solved with HiGHS, an upper-level adaptive neighbourhood search, benchmark policies and checks. The workflow combines platoon formation, refrigeration demand and vehicle-to-grid exchange. It draws 2024 German day-ahead prices and hourly weather from public APIs, and uses Solomon benchmark customer geometry and time windows. This model can test cold-chain delivery and charging scenarios across transport, food services and electricity systems. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this integrated scheduling code. Coverage is the benchmark instances and specified exogenous series, not an observed fleet. A limitation is that the README instructs code to download data at runtime, so reuse depends on external API availability and rights. The archive was not downloaded, run or checked against paper figures.
